description: Browser side as designed in plan.md: tablet call button, call panel, red #micNotice badge, grey #noiseNotice pill, noise meter, location reading and new heartbeat fields in public/app.js; dashboard ring banner, answer/hang-up, remote audio, noise and location text per tablet. Depends on FEAT-001's routes and event names (read its findings first).
steps:
public/index.html: add a 'Call' icon-button and a call panel (modal like #messagePanel: status text aria-live, Hang up button), `
● Microphone on
` beside #cameraNotice, and `
◐ Noise meter on (no sound is sent or kept)
`. The button is hidden unless /api/config features.intercom is on, window.isSecureContext, navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia and RTCPeerConnection exist, and NO_STREAM is not set.

public/theme.css: .mic-notice (copy .camera-notice, red #b3121f, shown with .on), .noise-notice (small muted pill, bottom corner, shown with .on), call button and call panel styles in the existing dark/light theme variables.

public/app.js: top-level functions noiseLevel(db, talkingDb, loudDb) and loudestBlock(blocks) (third loudest of ten, plain functions so tests can extract them with new Function); call flow: button -> POST /api/intercom/ring (no microphone, no RTCPeerConnection yet) -> on nobody show the message; on 'intercom' SSE state 'answered' ONLY then call getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:true,noiseSuppression:true,autoGainControl:true}}), set track.enabled=false until pc.connectionState is 'connected', create RTCPeerConnection({iceServers:[]}), send offer/ICE via /api/intercom/signal, apply answer/ICE from the 'intercom.signal' SSE event (ignore events whose callId is not ours); show #micNotice from the real stream state and hide it when all tracks are stopped; panel texts Calling / Connecting / Connected / Nobody answered / Call ended / Could not start the microphone; hang up, ring timeout from the server event, and a local 60 s guard. getUserMedia for the call is called from exactly one function that is reachable only from the 'answered' handler.

public/app.js noise meter (only when features.noise.enabled, secure context, not NO_STREAM): own getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:false,noiseSuppression:false,autoGainControl:false}}) + AudioContext/AnalyserNode, RMS dBFS per 1 s block, 10 s report, level via noiseLevel with thresholds from /api/config; runs only while !document.hidden, display not off (activeControl displayEnabled !== false) and no call; stops all tracks and closes the AudioContext otherwise; shows #noiseNotice while running; nothing is recorded, buffered beyond the current block, or sent except {level, db}. Heartbeat gains secure, noise ({level,db} or null) with noiseStatus, location, locationStatus; an extra heartbeat when the level changes (at most one per 10 s). Location: features.location.enabled and secure -> navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition once at start and every 6 h (enableHighAccuracy false, timeout 20000, maximumAge 6 h), lat/lon rounded to 5 decimals, accuracy integer; errors map to denied/unavailable/timeout, insecure when not a secure context.

public/dashboard.html/js/css: add an #intercom section (ring banner with room name, Answer and Not now; during a call 'Talking with <room>', a timer, Hang up, a hidden `<audio id="intercomAudio" autoplay>` fed from pc.ontrack via srcObject; messages for 'Already answered by X', microphone refused, call ended). Open GET /api/admin/intercom/stream?client=<random id> with fetch and a stream reader sending the Bearer token when one is used (parse SSE event/data lines; reconnect after 3 s while signed in and the page is open); Answer is a click handler: POST answer, then getUserMedia({audio:true}), RTCPeerConnection({iceServers:[]}), apply the tablet's offer, send answer and ICE via /api/admin/intercom/signal; flashing document.title and a best-effort WebAudio tone (wrapped in try/catch). In load(): add noiseText(t) (level, dB, 'x s ago', or 'noise not measured') and locationText(t) (text plus a real <a> 'Open map' to https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=..&mlon=..#map=18/../.. with target=_blank rel=noopener, or 'location not reported (reason)'), and a plain-http warning when t.secure === false, to each device line, like batteryText.

Tests: test/tablet-page.test.js (call button hidden without secure context/NO_STREAM, getUserMedia for the call only inside the 'answered' path, no getUserMedia/RTCPeerConnection at script load, #micNotice markup and CSS, noiseLevel and loudestBlock behaviour with new Function, heartbeat sends secure/noise/location, meter stops when hidden/display off/in a call); test/dashboard-page.test.js (no code path in dashboard.js starts a call: only ring/answer/signal/hangup under /api/admin/intercom and no 'ring' POST; map link has rel noopener; CSP-compatible: no inline scripts or styles added).
acceptance_criteria: Opening the tablet page creates no RTCPeerConnection and calls getUserMedia only for the noise meter (visible #noiseNotice) until a door press has been answered
The dashboard has no control that starts a call
Pages still work when /api/config has no `features` (older server) and when the browser has no mediaDevices (plain http)
verification: commit locally on main (e.g. 'Pages: call button, microphone badge, noise meter, location and dashboard answer panel'), never push
findings: Committed on main; npm run check: 264 tests pass. Not run in a real browser yet (FEAT-003). Tablet (public/app.js, appended block): globals SECURE, CAN_MEDIA, features, door (call state), noise, place; functions noiseLevel, loudestBlock, callSupported, pressCall (POST /api/intercom/ring, no mic), onIntercomEvent ('intercom' SSE; 'answered' -> startCallMedia, the only call getUserMedia + only new RTCPeerConnection), onIntercomSignal ('intercom.signal'), endCall, startNoise/stopNoise/syncNoise, readLocation, startExtras (called in initializeRoom after connectStream). Element ids: callButton (class hidden until supported), callPanel, callStatus, callHangup (text Hang up/Close), callAudio, micNotice, noiseNotice (class 'on' shows). Call guard 60 s ringing, 30 s after answered. Noise: 100 ms ticks, 1 s blocks, report per 10 blocks; heartbeat sends secure, noise, noiseStatus, location, locationStatus. Dashboard: section #intercom (#intercomText, #intercomAnswer, #intercomDecline, #intercomHangup, #intercomAudio); intercom state object with client id (24 hex), startIntercom() called after sign-in/Connect; Answer posts /api/admin/intercom/answer first, then getUserMedia({audio:true}). Device lines show noiseText/locationText (Open map link rel=noopener) and a plain-http warning. For e2e: Answer button click on #intercomAnswer; tablet button #callButton; fake media flags give a mic. Existing battery test regexp in test/tablet-page.test.js was loosened to allow extra heartbeat fields. Untracked .agents/ left uncommitted.
